_about: Establishments flagged "Outpatient Reporting" = Y in HEALTH-001 Health Hospitals (SLIP), plus sites shown with NADC = Y in a verbatim extract of the official Establishment List. Not a certified NADC reporting list. See docs/ESTABLISHMENTS.md.
_attribution: © Government of Western Australia, Department of Health, via SLIP / data.wa.gov.au (HEALTH-001). Licence listed as "Not specified" on the catalogue. Official-list rows: WA Health Establishment List (health.wa.gov.au), read through a search-index extract.

establishments.name: Perth Children's Hospital
establishments.hspNote: Perth Children's Hospital is part of CAHS (DoH CRS page, 8 Sep 2026; SLIP lists it under the North Metro geographic service).

establishments.name: Abrolhos Islands Health Centre
establishments.hspNote: Official Establishment List extract: NADC = Y. HEALTH-001 lists the same code as "Abrolhos Islands Nursing Post" (new ID, previously Abrolhos Island Health Centre 6024) without the outpatient flag.

establishments.name: Bethesda Hospital
establishments.hspNote: Private hospital. Official Establishment List extract: 602 Bethesda Hospital, NADC = Y (with HMDC and SANADC). Not flagged in HEALTH-001. Shown under NMHS only because SLIP places it in the North Metro geographic service; the arrangement that puts a private hospital in the NADC (for example publicly funded outpatient services) is not verified.

establishments.name: St John of God Bunbury Hospital
establishments.slipName: St John of God Bunbury Hospital
establishments.hspNote: Private hospital (St John of God Health Care) in the WACHS South West area; HEALTH-001 flags outpatient reporting. Contract detail not verified.

establishments.name: St John of God Mt Lawley Hospital
establishments.slipName: St John of God Mt Lawley Hospital
establishments.hspNote: Mount Lawley Hospital: purchased from St John of God Health Care by the WA Government, transferring to State ownership on 31 Aug 2026 (WA Government media statement, 1 May 2026); listed on the EMHS website (26 Oct 2026). HEALTH-001 still lists it as Private. Code 629 is the SLIP code; the official list was not seen for this row.

establishments.name: Joondalup Health Campus
establishments.hspNote: Joondalup Health Campus is operated by Ramsay Health Care under a public-private arrangement; listed under NMHS on the DoH CRS page. HEALTH-001 lists it as Private.

establishments.name: Peel Health Campus
establishments.hspNote: Peel Health Campus returned to public hands (SMHS) on 13 Aug 2024; listed under SMHS on the DoH CRS page. HEALTH-001 still lists it as Private under code 645. Search summaries of the May 2026 Establishments list say the public code is 145 (645 an older or private-era code); not verified, so the SLIP code is kept.

establishments.name: Beacon Health Centre
establishments.hspNote: Official Establishment List extract: 4281 Beacon Health Centre, NADC = Y. HEALTH-001 has a "Beacon Health Centre" under 6025 (Private nursing post) without the outpatient flag. Matched by name and place; coordinates from that SLIP row.
